premises.text: Online gaming today is anonymous and static with no control over who you play with
premises.evidence_span: the online gaming environment today, it's pretty static. You don't know who you're playing with. You're dealing with anonymous gamer tags

premises.text: Women gamers often mute mics because of hostile comments
premises.evidence_span: if you're a girl, chances are you're not going to turn on your mic. Because if you do, you're going to get the inevitable, go make me a sandwich comment

premises.text: Rich profiles with blogs, pictures, chat, and videos enable deep social engagement before optional play
premises.evidence_span: We offer rich user profiles, deep engagements with other users, including profiles that include blogs, pictures, and you're able to chat online, you can post your videos, and if you decide to, you can play a game

premises.text: Payers pay and play dates earn money, addressing supply and demand monetarily
premises.evidence_span: The payer, as we call it, pays, and the play date actually makes money playing that game. It offers greater control of your environment and monetarily addresses the issues of supply and demand

premises.text: Respectful ratings earned from prior play dates signal whether a payer is safe to accept
premises.evidence_span: she can actually see my respectful rating, which is what I've earned by playing other play dates before me

value.text: A fun, inviting, secure place to meet gamers and play them online with control
value.evidence_span: we are a fun, inviting place to play. We're secure. You can come in, meet gamers, and play them online

causal_links.evidence_span: monetarily addresses the issues of supply and demand

notes: Sports-bar story is analogy framing, not a premise. 10k viral users excluded as traction. Flash/console game catalog and tip UI folded into social play product (§4.1(5)). Developer CPM payout teaser treated as GTM aside without a full commercial module — omitted.
